学校简介

About our school

“文韬”出自《六韬》——文采与韬略并重。我们取这个名字，是希望孩子学中文不只是认字、考试， 而是能读书、会表达，慢慢把中文变成自己的本事。

Why we teach · 为什么教中文

给华裔家庭的孩子 · For heritage families

中文是家里的语言，是孩子和爷爷奶奶、外公外婆说话的语言，也是他们文化里的根。 我们希望孩子不只是“听得懂”，而是能读、能写、能表达，把中文真正变成自己的本事，一代一代传下去。

For children in Chinese-speaking families, Mandarin is the language of home — of grandparents, stories and roots. Our goal is that they go beyond understanding: reading, writing and expressing themselves in Chinese with confidence, so the language stays alive in the family.

给对中文感兴趣的孩子 · For children new to Chinese

对没有中文背景的孩子来说，中文是一扇新打开的门。我们从兴趣出发，让孩子先觉得中文好玩、 敢开口说，在一次次对话和交流里，慢慢爱上这门语言和它背后的文化。

For children with no Chinese background, Mandarin is a new door opening. We start from curiosity and fun, so children enjoy their first words, speak up bravely, and fall in love with the language — and the culture behind it — through real conversation.

How we teach · 我们怎么教

华裔系统班 · Heritage Track

使用中国部编教材，从 Level 1 一直到 Level 6，按听说读写四个方面系统推进、稳步升级。 学完整个体系，孩子就为以后的 AP 中文考试和 HSK 汉语水平考试打下了坚实的基础。

We use China's national 部编 (Ministry-compiled) textbooks, from Level 1 through Level 6, building listening, speaking, reading and writing step by step in one complete system — a solid foundation for the AP Chinese exam and the HSK in later years.

兴趣启蒙班 · Discovery Track

使用《轻松学中文》（Easy Steps to Chinese）以及针对孩子特点准备的补充教材。 课堂上鼓励孩子开口，多对话、多交流，在轻松的氛围里先对中文产生兴趣，再一步步学下去。

We teach with Easy Steps to Chinese plus materials chosen for each child. Classes encourage students to speak up — lots of conversation and real communication — so interest comes first, and progress follows naturally.

校长介绍

Meet our founder & principal

刘

Wen Liu 刘雯

Founder & Principal · 创办人 / 校长

Wen Liu founded Wentao Academy in Granite Bay, California, and serves as the school's principal and lead teacher. She teaches every level herself — from a five-year-old's very first 横 and 竖 to older students reading stories and writing compositions — and designs the school's curriculum, worksheets and cultural activities.

She also teaches on Outschool, where her class “How to Choose a Meaningful Chinese Name” introduces children and families to the meaning, sound and characters behind Chinese names.

课程设置

Programs

Four strands run through every level: speaking & listening, characters & writing, reading & stories, and culture. Children are placed by level, not just by age.

启蒙中文

Foundations · ages 5–7
语

For young beginners and heritage learners just starting out. Pinyin, tones and everyday speaking through songs, games and picture books.

  • 拼音与四声 Pinyin & tones
  • 日常口语 Daily conversation
  • 儿歌与绘本 Songs & picture books
Live online · small group & 1-on-1

汉字与书写

Characters, strokes & calligraphy
字

Characters taught the proper way — stroke by stroke, by their Chinese names — building from basic strokes to radicals to confident, neat handwriting.

  • 基本笔画 Basic strokes: 横 · 竖 · 撇 · 捺 · 点
  • 笔顺与偏旁部首 Stroke order & radicals
  • 毛笔体验 Brush calligraphy
Try the stroke explorer below ↓

阅读与表达

Reading, stories & composition
读

For students who can already speak some Chinese. Graded readers, idioms and short compositions grow vocabulary — and the confidence to use it.

  • 分级阅读 Graded reading
  • 成语故事 Idioms & classic tales
  • 看图说话与小作文 Speaking & writing
Live online · small group & 1-on-1

文化与节日

Culture & festival classes
节

Language lives in its festivals. Seasonal classes celebrate 春节， 元宵， 端午 and 中秋 with lanterns, stories, food words and hands-on crafts.

  • 春节 · 元宵 Spring Festival & lanterns
  • 端午 · 中秋 Dragon Boat & Mid-Autumn
  • 亲子活动 Family activities
Seasonal · throughout the year

认识笔画

Try it: the basic strokes

Every Chinese character is built from a handful of basic strokes. Tap one to watch how it's written — this is exactly how we introduce them in class.

横héng

horizontal stroke

课堂小知识 · In class we call each stroke by its Chinese name from day one. English is only a first-day bridge — textbooks, worksheets and teachers everywhere use 横、竖、撇、捺， so learning the Chinese names first saves children from re-learning later.

上课方式

How classes work

一

线下授课 · Onsite

地点：Granite Bay 文韬中文学校，面对面教学。
In person at Wentao Academy in Granite Bay.

二

线上授课 · Online

通过 Zoom 进行教学，在家就能上课。
Live lessons on Zoom, from home.

节

文化不是附加题 · Culture is the lesson

Children remember the words they have used — the lantern they carried, the dumpling they named, the greeting they said to grandparents on video call.

名

名字里的学问 · The story in a name

A Chinese name carries sound, meaning and a family's hopes. Our signature class (below) explores exactly that — how to choose a name with a story worth keeping.

读

慢慢来，读进去 · Reading that sticks

Stories before drills. When a child wants to know what happens next in the story, new characters stop feeling like homework.

名
On Outschool · 特别课程

How to Choose a Meaningful Chinese Name

Our signature Outschool class, taught by Principal Wen Liu. Students explore how Chinese names are built — the sound of the tones, the meaning of each character, and the wishes families hide inside them — and leave with a name that truly means something.
